workforce-management-for-contact-centers.basis: forecasting 正文显示 configurable forecasting、right-size staffing、forecast management/compare models、email backlog 与 SLA 情景模拟；scheduling 正文显示 AI-powered scheduling、跨班次调整、intraday flexibility、coverage 保持和 agent schedule autonomy。预测→人员配置→排班→日内调整的主循环有正文支撑。
